Messages.Author: Hamdamcwa
Messages.Body:
>1)is the (1 point of) damage dealt by my zip gun preventable?

Yes

>2)does brainwash prevent Nosferatu Kingdome (and the like) from transferring
>blood from blood bank to the brainwashed vamp? If not so, can I move that
>blood to my pool (according to text brainwash prevent transfers TO the vamp,
>not from)?

You can still move blood ONTO the vamp via Nossie Kingdom, Ecoterrorists, etc,
but not off (since that is a Transfer action).

>3)is the damage dealt from Catatonic Fear preventable in some way?

Hmmm... In theory not with Combat Cards or most common effects, since it is
outside the combat structure, and all combat cards should be used inside combat
unless stated in the text (I believe - LSJ?)

In any event, it could be prevented using Heart of Darkness at superior, since
this (unlike most prevention effects) does not specify that it has to be used
in combat.

>If used during a Dawn Operation, is that damage aggravated?

No. Damage from CF happens outside combat due to the "special" effects of
S:CE. This means no Ventrue Dawn Op / Catatonic Fear decks, I'm afraid.

DH

Messages.Author: Halcyan 2
Messages.Body:
>1)is the (1 point of) damage dealt by my zip gun to my vamp preventable?

Yes it can be prevented.

>2)does brainwash prevent Nosferatu Kingdome (and the like) from transferring
>blood from blood bank to the brainwashed vamp? If not so, can I move that
>blood to my pool (according to text brainwash prevent transfers TO the vamp,
>not from)?

No it doesn't and no you can't respectively. Nosferatu Kingdom, Gang Territory,
Arcane Library, etc. are not considered transferring so you can continue to add
blood this way (which means you can have a ready minion with a Brainwash on
him). Note that removing blood from him is still considered making transfer to
him. So you can't put blood on or take blood from a Brainwashed vampire.

>3)is the damage dealt from Catatonic Fear preventable in some way?
>If used during a Dawn Operation, is that damage aggravated?

Well it inflicts damage outside combat so the only way it can be prevented
(thus far) is with Blood Tears of Kephran. And since it's outside combat, Dawn
Op doesn't affect it.

Halcyan 2
